name: Vansen ChemGuard Mechanic Trouser
description: Flat-front work trousers treated with a grease-resistant silicone-polymer finish that causes most oils and solvents to bead and wipe clean. The fabric is a stiff, dark graphite weave that softens slightly with wear. Popular in vehicle bays, fabrication shops, and any Tier 2 workspace where you're kneeling on concrete by noon.
functionality: Grease-resistant and light solvent-repellent surface treatment, reinforced knees
what_it_says: You're a trades professional — competent, practical, not interested in looking anything other than what you are.
story_hooks: Vansen's ChemGuard treatment degrades after roughly two years of heavy use — workers on tight budgets sometimes re-treat old pairs with black-market spray-on sealant of questionable quality.
A mechanic wearing a pristine, barely-used pair in a rough district stands out; either they're new to the work or they're not actually a mechanic.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sturdy, utilitarian silhouette with a straight leg cut that reads as no-nonsense industrial wear. The fabric has a matte graphite sheen that catches light subtly, giving an impression of durability and functionality rather than style. The wearer appears grounded and practical.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the hip and thigh with a straight leg taper. Designed for unrestricted movement during kneeling, crouching, and bending. A slight taper at the ankle prevents fabric from pooling over work boots.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-duty ballistic weave cotton-synthetic blend with silicone-polymer chemical-resistant treatment. The treatment creates a smooth, slightly slick surface that repels industrial fluids.
physical_description.texture: Initially stiff and rigid, with a fine diagonal weave pattern visible under close inspection. The surface is smooth and slightly waxy from the polymer treatment. Softens gradually with wear and washing, developing a subtle nap.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep graphite gray with minimal variation. No patterns; the weave structure creates subtle visual texture. Zipper and hardware are brushed steel.
physical_description.closures: Flat front with a traditional zip fly and button waistband. Belt loops are reinforced. No secondary closures needed.
distinctive_features: Silicone-polymer treated finish that beads and sheds oils and solvents
Double-stitched seams at stress points (crotch, inseams, waistband)
Reinforced knee panels with extra fabric layers for durability against abrasion
Cargo pocket on right thigh with velcro flap and interior tool loop
Deep front pockets angled for balance when carrying weight
Internal calf pocket for small tools or rags
Vansen Industrial woven label on inside waistband (Tier 2 brand indicator)
Subtle wear lines and creasing develop with use, signaling experience
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 corporate/industrial. High-quality functional wear issued or approved by mid-tier corpo fabrication and maintenance divisions. Not luxury, but premium-grade workskin.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearing these signals you're a skilled mechanic, fabricator, or technician in corpo-sanctioned work environments. They indicate you spend your days in vehicle bays, tool shops, and assembly floors. Not street—this is institutional uniform-adjacent apparel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in with visible creasing at the knees and seat. Faint stains from oils and solvents that bead and partially wipe clean but leave ghost marks. Small tears or patches at high-wear areas after 1-2 years of daily use. The stiffness gradually softens into a comfortable slouch.

image_prompt: Close-up fashion shot of graphite-gray industrial work trousers on a cybernetic mechanic model, kneeling on a concrete floor in a dimly lit vehicle bay. Overhead sodium lights cast warm amber shadows across the cargo pockets and reinforced knee panels, highlighting the subtle polymer sheen of the fabric. Oil stains create faint abstract patterns on the lower legs. The model wears scuffed work boots and has visible subcutaneous augmentations on their forearms. Moody, utilitarian atmosphere. Dark industrial background with tool racks and shadow. --ar 2:3 --v 6
